name: Easing Suffering

angles.text: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow is one of your own, stricken by a virulent corruption in Teldrassil near the Oracle Tree. Bringing her comfort honors the duty Sentinels bear toward their kin.
Aiding fallen night elf Sentinels on the roads of Darnassus's homeland helps preserve the fragile frontline against growing corruption in Teldrassil's boughs.

faq.answer: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow is a night elf guardian found ailing on the road to the Oracle Tree. A fast spreading rot has left her helpless and near death.
Lashwater Salve is a prepared remedy brought to ease the pain of Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow's virulent rot. It may not cure her, but it soothes her distress.
The salve eases Sentinel Eralya's breathing and brings her peace, but whether she will recover or succumb to the rot remains uncertain.
faq.q: Does Sentinel Eralya survive the affliction?

faq.answer: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow lies on the road leading toward the Oracle Tree in Teldrassil.
faq.q: Where can Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow be found?

faq.answer: Eralya suffers from a fast spreading rot that festers through her body. Its source is unknown, but the affliction grows more virulent with time.
The rot spreads and strengthens quickly through Eralya's body. Haste matters because each passing moment brings her closer to succumbing to its agony and corruption.
faq.q: Why is haste required to deliver the salve?

sections.body: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow lies on the road to the Oracle Tree, stricken by a rot spreading fast. To ease her agony, you bring her freshly made Lashwater Salve before the affliction takes firmer hold.
sections.title: A Race Against the Rot

sections.body: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow receives the salve, though her healers doubt it can drive out the blight. It quickly calms her labored breath. Whether she will survive remains uncertain, but she finds peace in her darkest hour.
sections.title: Peace in the Shadows

summary: Near the Oracle Tree, Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow lies stricken by a spreading rot. You carry Lashwater Salve to ease her pain and calm her failing breath.
